unknown-envelope-field.why: the profile adds no envelope fields

unregistered-contract.why: payload_contract is not in the registered set

dotted-contract-version.why: durable-record token pattern forbids minor versions

payload-shape-mismatch.why: the payload must validate against its kind schema

blob-unknown-classification.why: blob classification is required at write

blob-media-type.why: blob body media type is not accepted

blob-over-cap.why: blob body exceeds the registry cap

agent-writes-maintainer-kind.why: identity is maintainer-class; an agent claim fails closed

secret-shaped-member.why: a closed cred-ref payload rejects a secret-shaped member at the kind schema

handoff-open-with-ack-time.why: open handoff must not carry acknowledged_at

handoff-foreign-rewrite.why: only the seat a handoff names may acknowledge it, and only by acknowledging

handoff-ack-by-wrong-seat.why: an acknowledgement is written by the seat named in to

foreign-scope-write.why: an actor writes only its own role and scope

single-kind-revised.why: decision-note is written at revision 1 only

supersedes-skips-revision.why: supersedes names the immediately previous revision

identity-wrong-stream.why: identity role and scope match the stream

revision-beyond-binary64.why: numbers must be exact in IEEE 754 binary64

cred-ref-bearer-locator.why: an env locator is a variable name, not a value

cred-ref-token-in-seclusor-path.why: a credential-shaped value is rejected wherever the format would admit it

cred-ref-token-recipient.why: recipient is a public key or a name

decided-at-month-13.why: an RFC 3339 date-time is a real instant

handoff-acknowledged-at-revision-one.why: an acknowledgement is a later revision

handoff-acknowledged-by-owner.why: the owner cannot acknowledge its own handoff

decided-at-no-offset.why: an RFC 3339 date-time carries an offset

decided-at-space-separator.why: an RFC 3339 date-time uses T between date and time

stream-trailing-newline.why: no control characters anywhere in an entry, including inherited envelope fields

credential-in-key-ref.why: key_ref names a key-custody record, never key material

owner-retargets-and-acknowledges.why: a seat never acknowledges a handoff in its own stream

decided-at-leap-second.why: leap seconds are not accepted; stored instants stay totally ordered

handoff-created-with-ack-time.why: a new handoff carries no acknowledgement

decided-at-sub-microsecond.why: fractional seconds have at most six digits so every reader parses the same instant

week-with-body.why: a payload-carrier kind carries a payload, not a body

decided-at-hour-24.why: clock hours are 00 to 23 on every Python version

goal-id-duplicate.why: goal ids are unique within an entry

goal-rank-too-precise.why: a rank is a multiple of 1/16; renumber instead of halving further

goal-rank-out-of-range.why: a rank is within plus or minus 2^31

goal-status-not-lifecycle.why: status is a project-work lifecycle class

goal-without-outcome.why: a goal object has an outcome

goal-unknown-member.why: a goal object has no other members

goal-outcome-too-long.why: an outcome fits one line, like plain text

goal-parent-self.why: a goal is not its own parent

goal-rank-binary-spelling-of-0.1.why: the exact binary64 value of 0.1 is not a multiple of 1/16

goal-list-null.why: a goal list is an array; malformed payloads are reported, not raised
